description: grep conformance: GNU grep 3.12 in the oracle is the reference for status, stdout and stderr.

cases.name: grep: basic match
cases.script:
printf 'INFO start
WARN disk 91%%
ERROR db timeout
INFO retry
error: lowercase
INFO done
' > /tmp/app.log; grep ERROR /tmp/app.log

ERROR db timeout
INFO retry
error: lowercase
INFO done

cases.name: grep: recursive
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/t/src/sub /tmp/t/node_modules/x && cd /tmp/t && printf 'fn main() {}
// TODO: fix
' > src/main.rs && printf 'todo later
TODO now
' > src/sub/notes.md && printf 'TODO vendored
' > node_modules/x/index.js && printf 'plain
' > README; grep -rn TODO . | sort

cases.name: grep: pipeline status
cases.script: set -o pipefail; printf 'a\n' | grep b | cat; echo "status=$? ${PIPESTATUS[*]}"

cases.name: grep: endless max count
cases.script: while :; do echo x; done | grep -m1 x
